label: s1_side02_0035_camera_01
text: She may be old, but she’s still a fine tent, eh![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_02
text: It’s actually my dad’s, but he wasn’t using it, so I\njust helped myself to it.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_03
text: Say hello to our new base of operations for our\nsurvey of the Bloodmoon Beast![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_dog_01
text: Wow-ow!

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_04
text: Now, the Bloodmoon Beast is way more wary\nthan an ordinary Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_05
text: That’s why there have been so few sightings—or\nso they say.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_06
text: That means we’re going to need to do some slow\nand steady groundwork if we wanna find it![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_07
text: So, partner, what I’m going to need your help\nwith most...is [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]photographing Pokémon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_08
text: I want you to take photos of the Pokémon that\nappear around here on foggy nights.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_09
text: I’m looking for lots of pictures of a good variety\nof Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_10
text: Afterward, I’ll register your photo data into my\nhandy Pokémon Searcher![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_11
text:
Over time, that’ll train it to ignore any sign of
other Pokémon that live around here.\c
Clearing all that noise will let us pinpoint
exactly where the Bloodmoon Beast is![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_select_01
text: Brilliant!

label: s1_side02_0035_select_02
text: I don’t get it!

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_12
text: Whoa, you actually understood that?![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_13
text: I was just rattling off what the manual said.\c\nI picked this thing up at a thrift shop. I don’t\nreally understand how it’s supposed to work.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_14
text: Right! Who would![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_15
text:
To be honest, I’ve got no idea how it’s supposed
to work either.\c
I just picked this thing up at a thrift shop, and
that’s what it says to do in the manual.\c
I’m sure it’ll be fine, right?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_16
text: My preliminary surveys make me think there are\nactually dozens of Pokémon species that tend to\r\nshow up around the forest on foggy nights.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_17
text: We can split the load, so how about you try and\nsnap photos of [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]10 species [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]of Pokémon for me?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_18
text: How ’bout it, partner? If we tackle this together,\nI’m sure we’ll find the Bloodmoon Beast![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_19
text:
Oh, and we’re looking for clear photos that get
the Pokémon nice and big in the frame!\c
You’ll want to sneak up on foot to get close to
them—no riding on big, noisy Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0035_camera_20
text: Think you’re ready? Just say the word!\c\nOnce you’re good, we can set up in the tent\nand wait for a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]foggy night[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
